policy: Differential-fuzz mismatch signatures that may pass without a new finding. Values list the owning P1 beads. Acceptance (acceptance/*) and tool failures (tool-*) are never known gaps and always surface as findings. Of the frame signatures, only frame/bitmap-table and frame/ffi-stub are known; any other frame/* signature surfaces as a finding. Signatures are shell-style patterns. The only artifact normalization is the documented cml_ prefix / _<digits> suffix strip on section names.

sections/order.reason: Flapjack appends the user entry function after the other user functions while CakeML places cml_main directly after cml_generated_main; tracked by the entry_order.pnk corpus fixture.

bytes/user:*:len_eq.reason: Known lowering differences in user function bodies (constant-return ABI, call lowering) with equal section length.

bytes/user:*:len_ne.reason: Known lowering differences in user function bodies (extra/missing instructions around returns and calls).

layout/user:*.reason: User section base/length layout differences caused by the same tracked lowering differences.

bytes/generated_main:len_eq.reason: Generated entry initializer/call lowering differs from CakeML with equal length.

bytes/generated_main:len_ne.reason: Generated entry initializer/call lowering differs from CakeML with different length.

layout/generated_main.reason: Generated entry base/length layout differences caused by the same tracked entry lowering differences.

frame/bitmap-table.reason: cake_bitmaps .quad payload. Flapjack now derives one real word per lowered call continuation (2^(nextSpill+1), the original's frame-size encoding) instead of constant 2s; exact on spill-free programs (bitmap_calls [4,2,2], trivial [4]). Residual tracked by the bead: word VALUES when CakeML's allocator spills more than Flapjack's (8/16 vs 2), entries for Flapjack-spill-free functions where CakeML still emits 2^f', and entry-count drift from CakeML's dead-code elimination.

frame/ffi-stub.reason: Flapjack now emits the CakeML cake_ffi<name>: stub blocks (tail cdecl(ffi<name>), .p2align 4) in first-appearance order between the startup stub and cake_clear. Residual tracked by the bead: stubs for FFI names referenced only from unreachable code (Flapjack discovers names pre-DCE, CakeML removes dead code first; same family as the 8.5.10.1 lowering diffs).
